text:
alex: Hey team — I’m alex, starting today in Product Design. Quick checklist: I don’t have Figma access to the Redwood org yet, and I can’t find the product roadmap docs or the research playbook. Can someone point me to the right places or kick off invites?

mira: welcome alex!! excited to have you. :tada: Figma: we use the `redwood-design` org. I usually ask IT to add new designers to the org and the `product-design` team space. Can you DM your work email here?

alex: sent — alex@redwood.ai. thanks!

it-helpdesk: Hi alex — got the email. I’ll request Figma org invite and add you to `product-design`. Expect invites within ~15–30 mins. If you don’t see them, check spam or let us know and we’ll re-send.

design-bot: Figma invite sent to alex@redwood.ai for org `redwood-design` and teams `product-design`, `components-library`.

josh: FYI on the Figma side: once you’re in, open the shared library file called `RDW - UI Kit`. It’s under Files > Team > product-design. Also follow the tokens page in that file for spacing and colors. If you want quick edits to components, ping me and I’ll show the Branch workflow.

mira: roadmap + docs: main roadmap lives in Notion at https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Roadmap. We keep the quarterly goals page public to the org. For research process, see the Research Handbook page: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Research-Playbook — it has templates for recruitment, consent, and the eval matrix we use.

alex: awesome — I can access Notion but I don’t see the Research Playbook page (says restricted).

sam_pm: tagging product onboarding: alex, I’ll add you to the product workspace in Notion now. We also have a short new-hire checklist here: https://redwood-internal.notion.site/Product-Onboarding which includes orientation meetings, links to runbooks, and a prompt set for quick design checks.

mira: For research ops, @tori_research runs the weekly pairing sessions. Tori — can you add alex to the participant list and recommend 2 sessions this sprint?

tori_research: will do. added alex to the research calendar and the #research-sync invite. Also sending the recruit spreadsheet access now. Quick note: our remote consent form template is at the bottom of the Playbook.

alex: thanks all. small Q: is there a standard subject line or message we use when requesting Figma file access from external partners?

mira: we usually send this short template — you can paste it:```Hi <partner_name>,

We’re requesting view/edit access to the Figma file "<file name>" for our design work on <project>. Our team is part of Redwood Inference (redwood-design org). Please share permissions with alex@redwood.ai.

Thanks,
Alex (Product Design)```

josh: also pro tip — if you need quick local edits without waiting for library unlocks, duplicate the page into a personal file and work there, then open a PR (in Figma: File > Save local copy and create a Branch).

alex: got it. one last thing: who do I ping for access to user research recordings and the session transcripts?

tori_research: research recordings live in the `research-arch` Google Drive. I just shared a link to your email. If you need access to transcripts, we keep them in `research-arch/transcripts` and tag them by study.

it-helpdesk: All noted — Figma invite + Notion permissions + Drive share done. If anything still blocks, reply here and we’ll escalate.

mira: welcome again, alex. I’ll schedule a 30m intro to the design system and our current roadmap tomorrow at 10am PT. Looking forward to pairing. :slightly_smiling_face:

alex: thank you everyone — feeling unblocked already. See you tomorrow!"
